== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The D’Niss are a race of highly intelligent, sapient, and coordinated psychic insects. They are characterized by their ability to perform advanced magic, utilizing unique spellcasting symbols that resemble insect tracks rather than standard humanoid lettering. As a species, they are capable of executing complex maneuvers such as subspace blockades to isolate systems. They are predatory in nature, specifically targeting civilized and developed worlds for sustenance rather than barren ones. While their soldiers are described as locust-like armies, the primary D’Niss are titanic creatures with the capacity to consume entire stars. The species is led by a [[Swarm-Queen]] named [[Esh’kinaar]], whom the D’Niss worship as a deity and ruler. The soldiers exist solely to serve her, viewing all other sentient life as insignificant or as tools for their own purposes. Although the [[Titan Knights]] previously drove back the D’Niss swarm and were believed to have completed their mission, the threat of a new incursion remains a significant concern for galactic security. Past incursions have caused massive economic devastation to entire systems, and the potential return of the [[Swarm-Queen]] is a primary motivation for various galactic defenders.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The D’Niss are titanic, bug-like insects associated with the [[Swarm-Queen]] [[Esh’kinaar]]. These creatures possess the terrifying capability to consume an entire planet. Although their queen is currently under control and not on the verge of returning, the D’Niss remain a primary target for extermination.}}

== The Engineer ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The D’Niss are a group that [[Starhammer]] once fought against during his era of conquest, an era in which he was capable of tearing through a full-grown member of their kind. The threat of the D’Niss persists because they could reappear at any time.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The D’Niss are insectoid space monsters with unbroken shells, wings, and upper claws that serve the [[Swarm-Queen]]. Originally an increasing alien incursion, these magical villains attacked three [[Iron Hives]] and were fought by the Knights, leading to the formation of the [[Titan Knights]]. Though their war ended years before the narrator's ritual, the D’Niss have returned to conduct an incursion on the edge of [[Dark Space]]. These creatures, which can lurk in [[Subspace]] and channel [[Aether]] at massive [[scales]], feed on planets and burrow into every moon and planet within the [[Visiri system]]. As they gather armies for a new incursion, refugees flee their advance while various forces, including the [[Karoshan]] fleets and the [[Red Divine Titan|Red Titan]], engage them in battle.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Described as giant bugs resembling armies of locusts, the D’Niss are rare and magically valuable creatures that spawn smaller offspring. During an incursion on [[Visiria]], these beings devastated the system and caused significant losses to the [[Nova-Bots]]. [[The Last Horizon]] has faced this group, which includes entities capable of delivering sword-strikes that stretch between planets. While the Captain once ruined a mech against them, the D’Niss currently exist as a scattered, defeated, or imprisoned group removed from this universe. Notably, [[Sola Kalter|Sola]] was able to adapt psychic scanning techniques derived from the D’Niss.}}
